subject: Re: POC/Trial plan and RACI — ClearLake Health

From: Eva Morales <eva.morales@clearlakehealth.org>

Cc: Peter Singh <psingh@clearlakehealth.org>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery call — next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call today — Peter and I appreciated the demo and the detail on latency/cost tradeoffs. A few quick clarifications from our side before we move to a short POC:

- Success criteria: clinical note-generation accuracy (measured by ROUGE / custom scorer) + < 300ms 95th percentile latency for standard chart prompts.
- Timeline: hoping to run a 4-week trial with ~5k monthly API calls scoped to one hospital unit.
- Security: we need details on data retention and encryption in transit/at rest for the POC environment.

Can your team propose an evaluation plan and a RACI for the POC (who owns infra, app integration, security review, procurement)? Also confirm any procurement docs you need pre-POC.

Best,
Eva
Eva Morales
Director of Digital Transformation
ClearLake Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Eva Morales <eva.morales@clearlakehealth.org>, Peter Singh <psingh@clearlakehealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 18:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery call — next steps

Hi Eva / Peter — really great to meet you both. Thanks for outlining the success criteria and timeline. Below is a concise POC plan + proposed RACI and next steps. I added Lauren and Nikhil to cover security/procurement and infra details.

POC Summary (4 weeks)
- Scope: Clinical note generation for ED unit — ~1k sample encounters, up to 5k API calls/month.
- Success criteria:
  - Accuracy: target improvement vs current baseline (we'll run the baseline scorer you provide). Goal: +12% on your primary metric or absolute ROUGE-L >= 0.42 (whichever is clearer).
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for standard chart prompts under the dedicated POC instance.
  - Data handling: no customer PHI persisted beyond KV cache lifetime; encryption TLS1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0: Kickoff + access provisioning (test keys, VPC peering if desired).
- Week 1: Ingest 200 sample encounters, validate outputs; run baseline scoring.
- Week 2: Full run vs 1k sample dataset; performance & latency tests (sustained burst and steady-state).
- Week 3: Iterate prompt templates and quantization profile; re-run scoring.
- Week 4: Final scoring, executive summary, and decision meeting.

Proposed RACI (high level)
- Redwood Marissa (Sales) — Account owner / POC coordinator (R)
- Redwood Nikhil (Infra) — POC deployment, dedicated instance + monitoring (A)
- Redwood Lauren (Security/Compliance) — Security questionnaire, SOC2 evidence, encryption details (C)
- ClearLake Eva (Digital Transformation) — Sponsor / success criteria owner (A)
- ClearLake Peter (Clinical Ops) — Clinical evaluation and scoring lead (R)
- ClearLake Rajiv (IT Ops) — Network, VPC peering, procurement sign-off (R)

Attachments: I attached a short POC success criteria doc and will follow with a stakeholder mapping worksheet.

Next steps
1) Lauren to share the security checklist and required evidence.
2) Rajiv to confirm network / firewall constraints (cc'd — please confirm, Rajiv).
3) Eva to share baseline dataset + scoring script by end of week.
4) We schedule a 30-minute kickoff next Tue (proposal: 2026-07-21 10:00am PT).

If that looks good I'll create the HubSpot Milestone and send a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Hi all — looping in the security/procurement checklist and a stakeholder mapping workbook (attached). Quick notes on items I can own / expected asks:

- Security evidence: I can provide SOC2 Type II summary, encryption documentation, and a short network diagram for the POC. I'll share the SOC2 redact-ready PDF and an evidence pack this afternoon.
- Data retention: for the POC we can set retention to 24 hours for KV cache and no long-term logs containing PHI; we can also run in a private deployment if you need stricter controls.
- Procurement: typical PO + minimal terms for POC (30-day trial with an evaluation agreement). If procurement needs a contract redline, please send the redline to legal@redwood.com and I'll coordinate.

Stakeholder mapping (high level)
- ClearLake:
  - Sponsor: Eva Morales (Digital Transformation) — A
  - Clinical Owner: Peter Singh (Clinical Ops) — R
  - IT/Network: Rajiv Patel (IT Ops) — R (network & firewall)
  - Procurement: Melissa Huang (Procurement) — C
- Redwood:
  - Account Exec: Marissa Cole — R/A (customer coordination + outcome)
  - Infra Owner: Nikhil Sharma — A (deploy & monitor POC)
  - Security Lead: Lauren Bishop — C (evidence & questionnaire)

I've attached stakeholder_mapping_clearlake.xlsx — it has fields for stakeholder, role, decision authority, and contact. Rajiv / Melissa: if you prefer I can share the sheet as a Google Doc and allow comments.

I'll also put together a 1-page security FAQ tailored to the POC.

Thanks,
